description: How a wallet trades: buys and sells with SOL totals, net flow, listings and bids, which marketplace (Magic Eden order book vs AMM pools; OpenSea with a key), the collections it trades most, every flip (bought then sold: hold time and P&L before fees), a behaviour label (flipper / holder / mixed / lister / quiet) with the reason, and the first purchase inside the window. With OpenSea readable (a self-issued free key, or OPENSEA_API_KEY), plain transfers are included so 'was this airdropped, gifted or bought?' gets an evidence-based answer. Every figure says which feed it came from and what that feed cannot see. Read-only; needs no key.

includeOpenSea.description: Add OpenSea sales and transfers when OpenSea can be read (self-issued key or OPENSEA_API_KEY). Default true.

pages.description: Magic Eden activity pages of 100 events, newest first. Default 3.
